correctness.rationale: Integrating the stated acceleration yields a unique strictly positive first-return flight for every positive kick. The post-impact map is strictly increasing: \(P′(v)=\eta[T a(T)/w(v)-1]\ge\eta>0\). The fixed point condition is exactly equation (1) and every positive root implies a physically positive kick by the strict trapezoid inequality. A signed one-crossing integral establishes uniqueness of the maximum of \(I_\eta\); signs of \(P(v)-v\) prove the exhaustive orbit census and stability. Taylor expansion at \(r=1,\eta=1/2\) yields \(P(v)=v-(\sqrt6/(8\sqrt{g\tau}))v^{3/2}+O(v^2)\), giving \(n^2v_n/(g\tau)\to128/3\) and the summable error in the physical flight-time law. All standalone verification assertions passed; finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact full-parameter census of a natural one-wall exponential-drive impact model identifies a genuine subgravity bistability wedge and distinguishes forced persistence from spontaneous launching. The restitution boundary at one half changes the topology of periodic-state existence, produces a quantitative quadratic cusp, and separates finite-time Zeno collapse from an explicit non-Zeno logarithmic physical-time law. These model-specific sharp thresholds and finite-vs-infinite impact clocks are structurally informative beyond routine restitution computations.
